related_questions.question: How serious is it to get COVID-19 now?
related_questions.snippet: Many people with COVID-19, also called coronavirus disease 2019, recover at home. But for some, COVID-19 can be a serious illness. Some people may need care in the hospital, treatment in the intensive care unit and the need for breathing help. In some people, severe COVID-19 illness can lead to death.

related_questions.question: Why are so many people getting COVID-19 again?
related_questions.snippet: Once you have had COVID-19, your immune system responds in several ways. This immune response can protect you against reinfection for several months, but this protection decreases over time. People with weakened immune systems who get an infection may have a limited immune response or none at all.
related_questions.title: About Reinfection | COVID-19 - CDC

related_questions.question: How soon after being exposed to COVID can you pass it on?
related_questions.snippet: Researchers estimate that people who get infected with COVID-19 can spread it to others 2-3 days before symptoms start and are most contagious 1-2 days before they feel sick. if you have the Omicron variant, you may become contagious more quickly because of its shorter COVID-19 incubation period.
